data.desc: United Rentals, Inc. is the largest equipment rental company in the world. The company has an integrated network of 1,665 rental locations in North America, 44 in Europe, 47 in Australia and 18 in New Zealand. In North America, the company operates in 49 states and every Canadian province. The company's approximately 28,100 employees serve construction and industrial customers, utilities, municipalities, homeowners and others. The company offers a fleet of equipment for rent with a total original cost of $23.75 billion. United Rentals is a member of the Standard & Poor's 500 Index, the Barron's 400 Index and the Russell 3000 Index® and is headquartered in Stamford, Conn. Additional information about United Rentals is available at unitedrentals.com.
